back: A random, spontaneous change in an unstable nucleus, emitting alpha, beta and/or gamma radiation.
Nucleon number −4, proton number −2: a new element.
Nucleon number unchanged, proton number +1 (a neutron becomes a proton and an electron).
No change in A or Z; the nucleus loses energy.
Too many neutrons (beta decay) or too heavy (alpha decay).
Top numbers (A) and bottom numbers (Z) must each balance; use Z to name the element.
